title: Optional status endpoint and coverage
summary: stub_status is an optional build module exposing basic client counters. Missing, denied or malformed endpoints leave monitoring coverage unknown. Active includes idle waiting clients.
checks: Declare the endpoint and an explicit active-client threshold.
limitations: This endpoint does not expose complete upstream health or worker occupancy.
applicability: Open-source stub_status text format; live verified on 1.28

source.documentation_version: rolling documentation; features vary by build
